{"model": "claude-agentsight-mock", "max_tokens": 64, "messages": [{"role": "assistant", "content": "Put Admin on VLAN10 and Finance on VLAN20, in separate zones. They must not reach each other except Finance->Admin file server 192.168.20.5:445. Block everything else between them.

Site notes: switch `sw` already trunks VLAN10 and VLAN20 (tagged) to fw eth1. Admin hosts use 192.168.20.0/24 (gateway 192.168.20.1, file server 192.168.20.5 is in Admin), Finance hosts use 192.168.21.0/24 (gateway 192.168.21.1). Office LAN 192.168.10.0/24 stays untagged.
PLAN:
ip link add link eth1 name eth1.10 type vlan id 10; ip addr add 192.168.20.1/24 dev eth1.10; ip link set eth1.10 up; ip link add link eth1 name eth1.20 type vlan id 20; ip addr add 192.168.21.1/24 dev eth1.20; ip link set eth1.20 up; nft add rule inet filter forward iifname eth1.20 oifname eth1.10 ip daddr 192.168.20.5 tcp dport 445 accept"}]}
